primary_text: "Every time we bid on something a developer swoops in and outbids us by 200k." How many weekends have you wasted at auctions only to watch a developer snatch it away? It's exhausting and demoralising. There's a better path. Off-the-plan warehouses in Truganina are being offered direct to owner-occupiers at a fixed price. No bidding. No competing with developer money. Brand-new, purpose-built for small business. 20km from Melbourne CBD with Princes Freeway access. Limited units remain. Don't let another one slip away.
description: Buy direct at a fixed price — skip the auction process entirely
